environment: same Apple MPS, torch 2.8.0, bf16, eager attention, no quantization
axes: same eleven anchor axes, model-specific extraction at layer15; never reuse Qwen direction arrays
outcomes: same conditional choice scores, full-vocabulary choice mass, centered cosine and final-position attention
analysis: retain original task-specific bootstrap seeds and 3000 cluster resamples
compatibility_issue: Gemma native template has no system role; instruction merged into user turn. Model comparisons include role-format differences.
system_role_decision: Reuse pre-existing Gemma9B template verbatim: prepend system notice to first user turn, or user-only notice when no user turn exists. Same transformation for all five conditions.
axis_validation: original heldout accuracy/AUC gates reported without retuning or item selection; failed axes flagged and not treated as validated emotion readouts
publication: publish validated behavioral and qualified axis results for both tasks, preserve prior Qwen/Llama results
